lines: Club creation is admin-only - users can only request membership.
Head username or e-mail, with account suggestions while typing
Their name only for an invitation: the name the e-mail greets
-> Create club (top bar). An account heads the club at once; an e-mail no account uses sends an invitation, and you head the club until it is accepted.
The new head takes over; the old head retires.
Club, New head username or e-mail, Their name only for an invitation
-> Change head An account takes over at once; an invitation once it is accepted.

For one person who ended up with two accounts and cannot sign in to both. The account that heads a club is kept, or else the older one; it gets the other's history, clubs, head positions and sign-in methods. It cannot be undone.
Account [username or e-mail], Same person's other account [username or e-mail] -> Merge accounts Refused when both took part in the same session, or when both name the same account.
Shown only when there are two accounts or more. The fields suggest usernames as you type; no account is listed openly.

blocks.text: is_admin only; archived clubs vanish everywhere else (404) and stay here. Changing the head also removes the old head as engine owner, so that account can be merged later. A head invitation: the link works once, expires after 14 days and keeps the address only while pending; one pending invitation per club (a new one cancels the old). Resend makes a new link; if the e-mail cannot be sent, the admin gets the link to pass on.
